t: When you are afraid giving will leave you short
a: ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱلْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعِدُكُم مَّغْفِرَةً مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلًا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
p: Ash-shayṭānu yaʿidukumu-l-faqra wa ya'murukum bi-l-faḥshā', wa-llāhu yaʿidukum maghfiratan minhu wa faḍlan…
m: Satan threatens you with poverty and orders you to immorality, while Allāh promises you forgiveness from Him and bounty. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
